body:
CHECK of the original pinned MAINLINE-024 is complete. Fresh independent calculation reproduces all 171 numeric result fields; all 44 provenance pins match. No owner/upstream script was inspected as code, imported or run. Independent radius optimization selects the same three bay sizes. Filed least SF: pin 1.225527946881, Zylon 1.159090909091, Kapton 0.818028264063.

Sag is NOT charged: the 0.374346974907 m cap-rise scalar accompanies zero volume/lift deduction. Every closure spends the full-sphere 4889.44215019 kg. Cap rise alone does not define the boundary-compatible displacement integral; the separate owner amendment must supply it and rerun the budget.

The 109.701010474 kg Zylon row is fibre-only, already 12.186010474 kg above the pin before barrier, resin and attachments. No complete gas-tight system mass is closed. The inherited 150-400 kg pump conflicts with 50 kg for all systems: even full reallocation leaves 100-350 kg unbooked, before power and internal-pressure lift accounting.

Primary material/barrier rows and gas units were independently checked. Filament/rope creep does not qualify a membrane; source-condition permeation is not a complete service leak balance. Ten NFI rows retain those gaps, pillow area/boundaries, gauge/allowable transfers and inherited lattice assumptions. Inputs/models remain QUESTIONABLE; proposed assemblies and scale transfers remain PROJECTION. No arithmetic mismatch or certification. Original-file CHECK only; no new assignment named.
